title: ActivitySource
description: An activity source tells where an activity came from: a client, an appointment, a payment, an invoice, a document, a review or a cart. An activity references its source. One source can be referenced by more than one activity. A source does not change after it is created.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the activity source.

business_uid.description: The business unique identifier relevant to that source. Returned only by the reads across businesses. Null when the source has no business, or when its business was deleted.

source_name.description:
The name of the source the activity came from. A free string: the platform writes the values below, and integrations, apps and businesses write their own.

**Started by the business:**
- `initiated_by_staff` (older spelling: `staff_initiated`): a staff member created the activity.
- `automation`: an automation created it. With `source_campaign` = `scheduled_payments`, a scheduled payment.
- `api`: created through the API.

**Started by the client:**
- `website`, `Website`: a widget, form or button on the business website.
- `client_portal`: the client portal.
- `automatic_messages`: a link in an automatic message of the business. `source_campaign` holds the message template.
- `campaign`: a link in a campaign. `source_campaign` holds the campaign uid.
- `email`, `sms`, `invitation`, `forward`, `marketing`, `email_campaign`: a link sent by email, SMS, an invitation, a forwarded message or a marketing channel.
- `text_to_business_phone`: a text message to the business phone.
- `call`: a call to the AI voice receptionist. `source_campaign` holds the business phone number.
- `promotions_opt-in_by_keyword` (also `promotions_optin_by_keyword`, `Promotions opt-in by Keyword`): an SMS keyword opt-in.
- `rwg_redirect`: Reserve with Google.
- `AI Receptionist`, `AI Assistant`, `Messenger`, `Instagram`: the AI products, and the channel of the AI Receptionist.

**From an integration or app:** the integration's own name, for example `square`, `clover_integration`, `shopify_integration`, `QuickBooks Online`, `Constant Contact`, `Jotform`, `HubSpot`, `MYOB`, `Xero`, `Marketing Center`, `Thryv Leads`, `Social Ads`.

**From a business's own link:** any label that the business puts in its links, for example a domain, a form name or an ad identifier.

**Unknown:** `unknown`, an empty string, or null.

source_channel.description:
The channel inside the source, for example the widget or the medium. A free string, not an enum: integrations and businesses write their own values. Known groups:
- Website widgets: `client_portal_widget`, `contact_form`, `duda_contact_form`, `scheduler_widget`, `duda_calendar_widget`, `button`, `sidebar_widget`.
- Message media: `email`, `sms`.
- Staff creation: `manual_matter`, `manual_contact`, `csv_import`, `xls_import`, `xlsx_import`, `phone_import`.
- Integrations and AI: for example `square`, `AI Receptionist`, `Typeform`, `Hubspot`.
- Marketing media from a business's own links: for example `Paid Search`, `Organic Search`, `Referral`, `Direct`, `Social Media`.

Most sources have no channel (null or an empty string). Some older values are stored encoded (for example `ZW1haWw3D` for `email`) and are returned as stored.

source_campaign.description:
The campaign of the source, in the UTM sense: the label of what sent the link to the client. Its meaning depends on `source_name`:
- `automatic_messages` (and `client_portal`, `website` or `rwg_redirect` when the client came from a message link): the message template, for example `message_request`, `invoice_client_issued`, `send_link`, `client_reminder`, `schedule_notification`.
- `campaign`: the campaign uid.
- `call`, and the AI Receptionist: the business phone number.
- `automation`: `scheduled_payments`, for a scheduled payment.
- A business's own link: a free campaign label.

Null for most sources. Some values are stored encoded and are returned as stored.

source_url.description: The page where the activity started: the business website page with a widget, the client portal page, the online scheduling page, or the link of a message. An integration can write its own domain (for example `thryv.com`) or a label that is not a URL. Longer values are cut to 255 characters.

utm_params.description: The marketing parameters of the visit that created the source: the five UTM parameters and the Google Ads click identifier (`gclid`). Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature. Null when the source has none.

created_at.description: When the activity source was created.

updated_at.description: When the activity source was last updated. Equal to `created_at`: a source does not change.
